name: @auction/web
description: Read-only-first frontend for the AuctionHouse local demo dapp.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run check:contrast && npm run test

//dependencies.wagmi: PINNED TO 2.x ON PURPOSE. wagmi 3.x is current, but @rainbow-me/rainbowkit 2.2.11 declares peerDependencies.wagmi ^2.9.0 and has no v3 support. Installing wagmi 3 does not hard-fail at install time with npm's peer resolution, it fails at RUNTIME: RainbowKit reaches into wagmi 2 internals and the wallet modal silently renders empty. Do not bump wagmi past 2.x until RainbowKit ships v3 support. Same reason viem stays on 2.x.
//dependencies.tailwindcss: v4 is CSS-first. There is deliberately NO tailwind.config.js and NO postcss.config.js. Theme tokens live in @theme inside src/styles/theme.css.
